collection: Authors’ Ridge historical portrait communication cards
note: Internal record. These are purpose-selected historical portraits; no family or cemetery photograph is converted into a communication symbol. The four original book symbols are recorded separately in docs/authors-ridge-book-symbols.json.

assets.subject: Louisa May Alcott
assets.creator: George Kendall Warren
assets.collection: Library of Congress, Liljenquist Family Collection
assets.rights_basis: Historical photograph in the public domain; the Wikimedia Commons record explicitly marks the image public domain. Library of Congress states no known restrictions on publication. Creator died 1884; historical publication dates predate 1931.
assets.public_credit: Louisa May Alcott, George Kendall Warren, about 1870. Library of Congress, Liljenquist Family Collection. Public domain.
assets.intended_use: Portrait card in the Authors’ Ridge story, searchable card catalog, individual downloadable PNG and editable printable set.
assets.changes: No changes to the downloaded image bytes. The card renderer fits the whole image proportionally inside the card and adds a separate name label.
assets.visual_review: Reviewed the downloaded portrait, identity/source label, full proportions and card suitability on 2026-10-21.
